name: BPC-157
shortDescription: Body Protection Compound that accelerates healing of muscles, tendons, and gut tissue.
benefits: Accelerates tendon and ligament healing
Reduces inflammation in muscle tissue
Supports gut lining repair and leaky gut syndrome
Promotes angiogenesis (new blood vessel formation)
Neuroprotective effects supporting brain health
May reduce pain from injuries and chronic conditions
Supports joint health and cartilage repair
researchNotes: Derived from a protective protein found in human gastric juice
Multiple rodent studies show accelerated Achilles tendon healing vs. controls
Shown to upregulate growth hormone receptors in tendon fibroblasts
Research published in Journal of Physiology demonstrates gut cytoprotective effects
Currently in Phase II clinical trials for inflammatory bowel disease
suggestedDosage: 200–500 mcg per day, subcutaneous or intramuscular injection, split into 1–2 doses

name: TB-500
shortDescription: Synthetic version of Thymosin Beta-4 that promotes tissue repair and reduces inflammation.
benefits: Promotes systemic tissue repair throughout the body
Reduces acute and chronic inflammation
Improves flexibility and range of motion
Accelerates wound healing and scar reduction
Supports hair regrowth in some studies
Enhances endurance and muscle tone
Cardioprotective effects in cardiac injury models
researchNotes: Thymosin Beta-4 is a naturally occurring 43-amino acid peptide found in all human cells
Studies show TB-500 promotes actin polymerization critical for cell migration and repair
Research in Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences highlights cardiac repair potential
Demonstrated hair follicle stimulation in alopecia research models
Used in veterinary medicine for race horse injury recovery
suggestedDosage: 2–2.5 mg twice per week for 4–6 weeks loading phase, then 2 mg monthly for maintenance

name: Ipamorelin
shortDescription: Selective growth hormone secretagogue that stimulates GH release with minimal side effects.
benefits: Stimulates natural growth hormone release from the pituitary
Promotes lean muscle mass development
Supports fat metabolism and body composition improvement
Improves sleep quality and recovery
Anti-aging effects on skin elasticity and bone density
Minimal impact on cortisol and prolactin levels
Enhances IGF-1 production for cellular repair
researchNotes: Pentapeptide that selectively binds to ghrelin receptors in the pituitary gland
Clinical studies show significant GH pulse amplification without desensitization
Research demonstrates superior selectivity vs. GHRP-2 and GHRP-6 with fewer side effects
Often combined with CJC-1295 for synergistic GH release protocols
Studies in elderly subjects show improvements in bone mineral density
suggestedDosage: 200–300 mcg, 2–3 times daily via subcutaneous injection, ideally before sleep and post-workout

name: CJC-1295
shortDescription: Long-acting GHRH analogue that provides sustained growth hormone release over days.
benefits: Provides sustained elevation of growth hormone levels
Increases IGF-1 levels for enhanced cellular repair
Promotes fat loss, especially visceral fat
Supports lean muscle mass preservation and growth
Improves skin thickness and collagen production
Enhances deep sleep and recovery cycles
Long half-life allows less frequent dosing
researchNotes: Modified GHRH analogue with DAC (Drug Affinity Complex) extending half-life to 6–8 days
Phase II clinical trials demonstrated 2–10x increase in mean GH concentrations
Research shows sustained IGF-1 elevation for up to 28 days after single injection
Commonly paired with Ipamorelin for amplified pulsatile GH release
Published in Journal of Clinical Endocrinology & Metabolism
suggestedDosage: 1–2 mg per week subcutaneous injection; often combined with Ipamorelin at 300 mcg per dose

name: Epithalon
shortDescription: Tetrapeptide that activates telomerase to lengthen telomeres and slow cellular aging.
benefits: Activates telomerase enzyme to extend telomere length
Slows cellular aging at the DNA level
Improves melatonin production and circadian rhythm
Enhances antioxidant enzyme activity
Supports immune system function in aging populations
May reduce risk of age-related diseases
Improves skin texture and reduces age spots
researchNotes: Discovered by Professor Vladimir Khavinson at the St. Petersburg Institute of Bioregulation
Studies show telomere elongation in human somatic cells after Epithalon treatment
Research in Bulletin of Experimental Biology and Medicine demonstrates lifespan extension in animal models
Clinical studies in elderly patients show normalization of melatonin secretion
Shown to reduce incidence of spontaneous tumors in aged rats by 2.4x
suggestedDosage: 5–10 mg per day for 10–20 day cycles, 2–3 times per year via subcutaneous injection

name: GHRP-6
shortDescription: Growth hormone releasing peptide that stimulates GH secretion and increases appetite.
benefits: Potent stimulation of growth hormone release
Increases muscle mass and strength
Promotes fat burning through elevated GH levels
Stimulates appetite — useful for muscle-building phases
Supports liver health and IGF-1 production
Anti-inflammatory properties
Improves recovery time between training sessions
researchNotes: Hexapeptide that acts on ghrelin receptors in the hypothalamus and pituitary
Studies show 7–15x increase in GH pulse amplitude vs. baseline
Research demonstrates significant appetite stimulation via ghrelin pathway activation
Shown to have cytoprotective effects on cardiac tissue in ischemia models
Often stacked with GHRH analogues for synergistic GH release
suggestedDosage: 100–300 mcg per injection, 2–3 times daily on an empty stomach via subcutaneous injection

name: PT-141 (Bremelanotide)
shortDescription: Melanocortin receptor agonist that enhances libido and sexual function in men and women.
benefits: Increases sexual desire and libido in both sexes
Improves erectile function in men
Enhances arousal and sexual satisfaction in women
Acts centrally on the nervous system, not vascular system
FDA-approved (Vyleesi) for hypoactive sexual desire disorder in women
May improve mood and energy levels
Rapid onset of action within 45–60 minutes
researchNotes: Cyclic heptapeptide analogue of alpha-MSH acting on MC3R and MC4R receptors
FDA approved as Vyleesi (bremelanotide) for premenopausal women with HSDD in 2019
Clinical trials showed significant improvement in sexual desire scores vs. placebo
Unlike PDE5 inhibitors, works via CNS pathway independent of sexual stimulation
Phase II trials demonstrated efficacy in men with erectile dysfunction
suggestedDosage: 1–2 mg subcutaneous injection 45–60 minutes before sexual activity; maximum 1 dose per 24 hours

name: Collagen Peptides (Type I & III)
shortDescription: Hydrolyzed collagen fragments that stimulate skin, joint, and connective tissue regeneration.
benefits: Improves skin elasticity, hydration, and reduces wrinkles
Supports joint cartilage health and reduces joint pain
Strengthens hair and nails
Promotes gut lining integrity
Supports tendon and ligament strength
Provides glycine and proline for collagen synthesis
Reduces visible signs of skin aging
researchNotes: Hydrolyzed collagen peptides are absorbed as di- and tripeptides and accumulate in skin dermis
Randomized controlled trial in Skin Pharmacology and Physiology showed 20% reduction in eye wrinkle depth
Research demonstrates stimulation of fibroblast collagen and elastin production
Studies show 40% reduction in joint pain in athletes after 24 weeks of supplementation
Bioavailability studies confirm peptide absorption and tissue-specific accumulation
suggestedDosage: 10–20 g per day orally, mixed in liquid; best taken with Vitamin C to support collagen synthesis

name: GHK-Cu (Copper Peptide)
shortDescription: Naturally occurring copper-binding peptide with powerful skin regeneration and anti-aging properties.
benefits: Stimulates collagen and elastin production in skin
Promotes wound healing and skin regeneration
Reduces fine lines, wrinkles, and skin laxity
Antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties
Stimulates hair follicle growth and reduces hair loss
Supports nerve regeneration
Remodels damaged skin and scar tissue
researchNotes: Tripeptide Gly-His-Lys naturally found in human plasma, saliva, and urine
Research by Dr. Loren Pickart demonstrates broad tissue remodeling and repair activity
Studies show GHK-Cu activates over 4,000 human genes involved in tissue repair
Clinical studies demonstrate significant improvement in skin density and thickness
Research shows stimulation of VEGF and FGF for angiogenesis and tissue repair
suggestedDosage: Topical: 1–5% concentration in serum or cream applied twice daily. Injectable: 1–2 mg subcutaneous 2–3x per week

name: Sermorelin
shortDescription: GHRH analogue that stimulates the pituitary to naturally produce and release growth hormone.
benefits: Stimulates natural pituitary GH production
Improves body composition — reduces fat, increases lean mass
Enhances energy levels and vitality
Improves sleep quality and duration
Supports bone density maintenance
Improves skin tone and reduces wrinkles
FDA-approved history with established safety profile
researchNotes: 29-amino acid analogue of endogenous GHRH (1-44), the shortest fragment with full biological activity
Previously FDA-approved as Geref for GH deficiency in children before being discontinued commercially
Clinical studies show restoration of youthful GH secretion patterns in adults over 40
Research demonstrates improvements in body composition comparable to exogenous HGH with better safety profile
Studies show normalization of IGF-1 levels in GH-deficient adults after 3–6 months of therapy
suggestedDosage: 200–500 mcg subcutaneous injection before bedtime, 5 days on / 2 days off cycling protocol
